concepts.name: MemberConformance
concepts.meaning: Inv(G), assertion membership and independent ConformsAt
concepts.required_boundary: A valid but unrecorded edge cannot support an observed fact.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: ConformsTo
concepts.meaning: reference × reference × scope; exact assessment-backed member conformance
concepts.required_boundary: Sealed initial observation; no caller facts or rule heads.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: TargetKind
concepts.meaning: reference × text; exact node kind through a checked vocabulary map
concepts.required_boundary: Independent sound/complete projection; kind text literal must be in captured domain.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: ExistentialConformanceView
concepts.meaning: Unary Conforms matches rich observations in projected initial inventory
concepts.required_boundary: No new rule writing old Conforms; not equality for arbitrary old models.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: SupportSet
concepts.meaning: Exact graph/assertion/assessment/profile witnesses for a deduplicated observation
concepts.required_boundary: Retain multiple supports; prove validity and source-support completeness.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: ProducerPolicy
concepts.meaning: Sealed observations versus derived ordinary information, orthogonal to root Role
concepts.required_boundary: Every initial source and rule head authorized by exact selected profile.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: RegisteredBaseline
concepts.required_boundary: Independently qualify before use; displayed version is not readiness.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: BaselineTransition
concepts.meaning: Named richer-snapshot change with explicit fact/domain/assessment differences
concepts.required_boundary: Distinct from fixed-domain rule-only expansion; no reused incompatible receipts.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: RecursiveFreshExtension
concepts.meaning: Fixed domain/roots/old rules/facts with positive fresh derived ordinary heads
concepts.required_boundary: Every-old-model expansion, finite stabilization, no unseeded facts.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: EvaluationKey
concepts.meaning: Profile, condition revision, exact context/snapshot, relevant endpoints and epoch
concepts.required_boundary: Consistent selected status; evaluator/interpretation identity bound.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: ConditionStatus
concepts.meaning: holds, does-not-hold, unknown; inconsistent selection gives conflict diagnostic
concepts.required_boundary: No absence-as-false; no contradictory evidence projects holds.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: PotentialNorm
concepts.meaning: Inherited interpreted norm with exact Origin support
concepts.required_boundary: No claim of true condition, subject conformance or fulfillment.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: ActiveNorm
concepts.meaning: PotentialNorm plus exact checked ConditionHolds in its context
concepts.required_boundary: False, unknown or mismatched context cannot activate; supplied truth explicit.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: ActiveConflict
concepts.meaning: Active require and active forbid at same subject/action/scope/evaluation context
concepts.required_boundary: Separate potential conflict; permit neither erases conflict nor grants authority.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: ClaimScope
concepts.required_boundary: No advertised guarantee beyond actually satisfied obligations.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: ResourceEnvelope
concepts.meaning: Early conservative bounds and measured stage work/time/allocation ceilings
concepts.required_boundary: Exhaustion is unknown and blocks closure, absence and readiness.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts

concepts.name: SourceInterpretation
concepts.meaning: Exact qualifier/source/context-to-typed witness for a selected fragment
concepts.required_boundary: No guessed strings; extra fields mapped, assumed or explicitly unsupported.
concepts.disposition: preserve accepted v2 meaning; extend only through named independent successor contracts
